description.value: Rhythm Chinese Restaurant (also known by its Chinese name 逸站) is a sit-down and takeout Chinese restaurant on Fifth Street in Nanaimo. The restaurant offers dine-in service alongside pickup and local delivery, with online ordering available directly through their website. It presents itself as a neighbourhood spot emphasizing value and a broad range of Chinese dishes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at rhythmtogo.com was successfully fetched and confirms the business name, address (530 Fifth St, Nanaimo, BC V9R 1P1), and phone (250-591-2288), none of which were present in OSM tags. The website explicitly advertises dine-in, pickup, and delivery, confirming takeout. No bike-specific amenities (rack, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website only.

Privacy Policy and Terms pages state 'Country refers to the United States', indicating use of a generic US-based legal template despite the business being located in Canada — minor template inconsistency, not a business legitimacy concern.
OSM name omits the Chinese subtitle (中文名逸站) present on the website; not a mismatch but worth noting for completeness.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate, active restaurant suitable for a cycling stop, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. An on-site visit or direct contact would be needed to verify these before including.

wow_evidence: neighbourhood spot emphasizing value and a broad range of Chinese dishes
